prompt:

Header text verbatim: "sexton". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "sixteen".
Scene: Exactly sixteen separate blue buttons arranged in a strict 4 by 4 grid on cream cloth, large numeral 16, adult hand pointing outside grid.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "sexton = sixteen; count 4 rows of 4.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Hon räknar sexton knappar.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
styleReference: Established card style described in the prompt; no image supplied.
